requirements: ApprovalSignature64 is Ed25519 raw64 only; shared device Ed25519PublicKey is not a universal person-key/native-helper algorithm. All bytes scalar values are bounded lowercase-hex strings; lengths alone confer no key validity, signature validity, assurance or admission.

ApprovalSignerObservation.public_key must equal the exact independently admitted descriptor/current signer-incarnation key; recompute signer ID from canonical raw key bytes. Union consistency or self-signing does not admit the key, prove person equality or establish strength.
Ed25519 is raw32 public and raw64 signature over exact message M with strict verification. Reject Ed25519ph/prehash substitution; do not truncate P256/DER/provider/RSA blobs into this shape.

P256 public is canonical SEC1 uncompressed65 04||X32||Y32, valid non-infinity point on secp256r1. Signature uses ECDSA SHA256(M), strict ASN1 DER minimal positive r,s integers, 1<=r,s<n and no trailing bytes. Canonical governance additionally enforces s<=floor(n/2). Generated bounds8..72 do not perform these semantic checks.

The two P256 material tags denote encoding/verification policy, not independent algorithms or assurance. Exact purpose plus admitted descriptor selects policy before parsing material; no caller tag fallback or alternate verifier on malformed, mismatched or unsupported input.

Generic legacy approval DER and strict low-S governance have distinct retained verifier boundaries. High-S observations are permitted only where the retained purpose verifier permits them; their bytes are not rewritten, relabeled as low-S or upgraded to governance authority. This is source-format fidelity, never legacy trust migration.

Normalize only newly generated trusted-provider ECDSA output after validating provider result and before record publication. Never normalize historical signed envelopes, IDs or stored observations. Mathematical low-S validity alone never supplies required admission, governance threshold or fresh presence.

Dedup both P256 tags and all valid randomized signatures by stable admitted signer/person plus exact purpose operation nonce and authority generation. Signature bytes or policy tags never create another vote/effect, reset holds/fatigue or alter immutable operation IDs. Preserve one-time consume and durable result/effect receipts.

All existing purpose transcripts and original integer millisecond fields remain exact. General shared unsigned decimal-string/UnixMicros wire representation is not historical signing input. Preserve domain prefixes and newline/NUL, original canonicalization, key/decision binding and issuer/subject role distinctions.

Native certificate currently verifies P256 subject descriptor through a separately admitted Ed25519 issuer. Issuer algorithm/root identity is independent from subject hardware/custody/presence assurance. Descriptor signature is not proof the platform can issue its subject algorithm or that root admission exists.

Protected helper derives exact message internally, selects admitted algorithm for purpose without caller negotiation, and never signs caller arbitrary digests. Hash-taking ECDSA API receives SHA256(M) exactly once inside protected boundary; avoid double hashing. Raw/DER/provider conversions are trusted adapter duties, never public authority.

No public operation accepts ApprovalSignatureMaterial or exposes arbitrary sign/decide. The added family describes paired key/signature transcript-format evidence only. All prior roots thresholds holds cancellation distrust first-complete observations fatigue distinct-people and generation constraints remain in force.
